title: Output bit rule
statement: Let $lm$ be a Boolean, let $O$ be a finite list of Booleans, and let $p$ be a natural number. If $lm$ is true, the output is true exactly when $p$ is less than the length of $O$; otherwise, the output is the entry of $O$ at position $p$, taking false when that position is absent.
